turnAssumption.note: One authoritative simulation turn is one in-game calendar day. Production, transport ETAs and construction progress are driven by the central simulation clock.

rules: Every required input is checked and consumed together in one committed factory cycle.
A missing required input blocks the complete recipe without consuming other ingredients.
Output coefficients and unit metadata are defined in the catalog; unknown observed quantities must not be presented as observed facts.
Factory capacity is a per-day simulation profile, never inferred from a single shipment quantity.
By-products and residues are persisted as separate batches.
